commands:
# Preparation ONLY after a separate exposed-case recipe is declared. No GPU job in this audit.
# Existing prefix.npz holds prefix observations and complete known controller schedules.
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 runs/phystwin-env/bin/python - <<'PY_PREP'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.real_transfer_v19.phystwin_run import load
from scripts.gaussian_boundary_flow_v02.export_inputs import reduce_geometry, write_package
from scripts.gaussian_boundary_flow_v02.affine_observation import affine_observation_matrix
cases=['single_lift_dinosor','double_lift_sloth','double_stretch_sloth','double_stretch_zebra']
for case in cases:
    prefix=Path('runs/real-transfer-v19/inputs/incoming-v22')/(case+'-240')
    assert (prefix/'manifest.json').is_file() and (prefix/'prefix.npz').is_file() # forbid exporter fallback to full raw pickle
    data,meta=load(case,240,False) # verifies existing prefix archive hash, reads no evaluator target
    data['mask_version']='incoming-v22'
    data['source_prefix_archive_sha256']=meta['prefix_sha256']
    for nodes in (64,120):
        reduced=reduce_geometry(data,nodes)
        reduced['observation_matrix'],audit=affine_observation_matrix(reduced['nodes'],reduced['observed_initial'])
        reduced['observation_map_revision']={'rule':'Initial-only affine-complete map','maximum_row_l1':audit['maximum_row_l1'],'maximum_row_l2':audit['maximum_row_l2'],'negative_weights_allowed':True}
        write_package(reduced,Path('runs/gaussian-boundary-flow-v03-phystwin-remaining-inputs')/(case+'-nodes'+str(nodes)))
PY_PREP

# CPU geometry qualification BEFORE choosing/launching each case:
# Instantiate GeometryAwareGaussianBoundaryBackend(load_package(PACKAGE),'cpu').
# Its constructor rejects disconnected/unused nodes. Record nodes/elements/volume and
# choose64 if valid, else120 if valid; if both fail, report failure without substituting a case.
# Preserve this geometry decision before any prefix-bank fitting or suffix evaluation.

# Example only once PACKAGE has passed the declared initial-only geometry gate:
.venv/bin/python -m scripts.gaussian_boundary_flow_v02.package_campaign_v03 --geometry filtered --package PACKAGE --output RUN --samples 128 --steps 5000 --draws 32 --device cuda:0
# CLI flags require spaces: --samples 128 --steps 5000 --draws 32.
# Then freeze derived/retrieval outputs using the same engines as compact expansion,
# and use object_score on complete seals only. Keep within-case budgets identical.
limitations: Estimated3Dtracks and supplied initial geometry are privileged observations; this is not raw-video-only end-to-end inference.
PhysTwin lacks material/force ground truth; no calibrated physical-parameter recovery claim.
Recorded held-camera rendering comparisons need a distinct image protocol; arbitrary novel views have no groundtruthRGB.

Long stretch clips have134/138prefixframes and192/198totalframes; canonical continuation solves every intermediate controller frame, even with12observationframes. This predicts larger runtime, not a reason to drop cases.
